posts.name: Jeysie
posts.cooked:
mori57:

Hum. Why won’t any of my attempts to link to one of my images show up?

Poking through the page code, it looks like the forum is trying to display it as an embedded image but can’t because it’s a link to Google’s wrapper webpage rather than the actual image. I think you’d have to either manually create an actual link to the wrapper webpage or make sure you’re embedding the actual image file (if the URL has PNG or JPG it’s more likely you found the direct URL to use).
